title: Procure to Pay (P2P) - 4-Workflow Baseline Spine & Shoppable Enterprise Connectors

executionSemantics.deterministicRuleResolution: Declarative predicate and function bindings resolved at package load time against FlowCraft's registered deterministic predicate catalog (not freeform runtime LLM prompts).
executionSemantics.mutationTiming: Versioned package overlays compiled and approved prior to workflow activation; running in-flight workflow instances remain bound to their pinned package hash.
executionSemantics.stagingIsolation: Function Steps (Step 2) stage candidate numbers and receipt slots inside an uncommitted SQLite/PostgreSQL savepoint; if Validation Step (Step 3) or Business Rule Step (Step 4) fails, the savepoint rolls back and routes to the named exception loop.

catalogConventions.bpsRefMeaning: Business Process Standard (BPS) catalog identifier indexing the 66 enterprise outcome families across the 6 constellations.
catalogConventions.catalogFamilyPrefix: P2P01..P2P10 (Procure-to-Pay outcome families inside the 66-family baseline catalog)

bpfWorkflowShopping.chartingToolUsed: Archify (lightweight flowchart canvas inside B.O.S.S. used during live discovery sessions; modeling tool only, not the runtime engine)

baselineWorkflowChain.title: Workflow #1: Purchase Requisition & DOA Approval Tree
baselineWorkflowChain.inputContract: Purchase Need (Item/Service Spec, Qty, Cost Center)

haraSockets.humanSeat: Department Requisitioner -> Cost-Center Approver ($5k Mgr / $50k Dir / >$50k VP)

governancePins.pin2IndependentReview: WA-COMMIT validates GL dimension combination prior to routing DOA approval
governancePins.pin3AuditableEvidence: SHA-256 signed requisition approval receipt persisted to p2p.purchase_requisition
governancePins.pin4NamedHumanApproval: Named DOA seat sign-off ($5k Mgr / $50k Dir / >$50k VP)

canonicalSteps.title: Submit Requisition Cart (Inventory SKU or Service SOW)
Resolve Catalog Vendor Price & GL Cost-Center Dimensions
Verify Budget Encumbrance & Segregation of Duties (SoD)
Execute DOA Approval Tree Sign-Off -> Emit Approved Requisition

baselineWorkflowChain.title: Workflow #2: Purchase Order Generation, Dispatch & Supplier Ack
baselineWorkflowChain.outputContract: Issued Purchase Order [po_no, status=ISSUED_OPEN] + Expected Receipt Slot
baselineWorkflowChain.returnLoop: Loop L2 (PO Change Order / EDI 860 -> Re-Validate DOA & Sync Receiving)

governancePins.pin2IndependentReview: Verify PO line total <= approved requisition encumbrance ceiling
governancePins.pin3AuditableEvidence: Immutable PO dispatch envelope + encumbrance journal entry

canonicalSteps.title: Review Approved Req & Confirm Delivery Incoterms / SOW Schedule
Stage Provisional PO-##### & Expected Receipt Slot in Savepoint
Verify Supplier Dispatch Channel & Payment Terms Before Commit
Commit PO Savepoint Outbound & Record Supplier Acknowledgment

baselineWorkflowChain.title: Workflow #3: Inbound Receiving - Bill of Lading (BOL), Shipper & System GRN
baselineWorkflowChain.inputContract: Open PO [po_no] + Carrier Bill of Lading (BOL) + Vendor Shipper/Packing Slip (or Service Entry Sheet)
baselineWorkflowChain.outputContract: Posted System Receipt [grn_no, bol_no, packing_slip_no, qty_received]
baselineWorkflowChain.returnLoop: Loop L3 (Dock Discrepancy / Quarantine / RTV Return Order)

haraSockets.agentHarness: WA-FULFILL (BOL/Packing Slip OCR & GRN Ledger Coordinator)

governancePins.pin1DeterministicControls: po.status == ISSUED_OPEN && bol_no != null && packing_slip_no != null
governancePins.pin2IndependentReview: Cross-check physical dock scan against PO open line quantity tolerance
governancePins.pin3AuditableEvidence: Indexed BOL + Shipper PDF hashes linked to grn_no and GR/IR subledger accrual
governancePins.pin4NamedHumanApproval: Receiving Dock Clerk or QA Lead physical sign-off

canonicalSteps.title: Receive Carrier at Dock, Inspect Freight & Capture BOL + Shipper/Packing Slip (or Service Log)
Index BOL + Shipper PDFs & Stage Goods/Service Receipt Note (GRN) in Savepoint
Verify Received Qty & Lot Against Open PO Line Tolerances
Post System Receipt (GRN), Update Inventory & Post GR/IR Accrual

baselineWorkflowChain.title: Workflow #4: Vendor Invoice Capture & Deterministic 3-Way Match
baselineWorkflowChain.inputContract: 1) PO [po_no] + 2) System Receipt [grn_no + bol_no + packing_slip_no] + 3) Vendor Invoice [inv_no]
baselineWorkflowChain.outputContract: Posted AP Voucher [vch_no, status=READY_FOR_PAYMENT] or Hold Loop L4
baselineWorkflowChain.returnLoop: Loop L4 (Price Variance -> routes to WF #2 Buyer Loop L2; Qty/BOL Variance -> routes to WF #3 Receiving Dock)

governancePins.pin1DeterministicControls: abs(inv_unit_price - po_unit_price) / po_unit_price <= 0.02 && price_variance_usd <= 250.00 && inv_qty <= grn_qty_accepted
governancePins.pin2IndependentReview: Zero-LLM deterministic 3-way join across PO, GRN/BOL, and Vendor Invoice
governancePins.pin3AuditableEvidence: Balanced double-entry AP voucher receipt (sum(debits) == sum(credits))
governancePins.pin4NamedHumanApproval: AP Specialist posts under delegated policy AP-DOA-2026.3 (<= 2.0% and <= $250.00); Controller sign-off required above threshold

canonicalSteps.title: Ingest Supplier EDI 810 / Verified Invoice into AP Queue
canonicalSteps.deterministicRule: inv_no != null && vendor_id != null && po_no != null

canonicalSteps.title: Assemble 3-Way Match Dossier: Join PO x GRN (BOL/Shipper) x Invoice
Run Deterministic 3-Way Match Tolerance Check (Price <= 2% and <= $250, Billed Qty <= Accepted GRN Qty)
Auto-Post Verified AP Voucher or Fire Exception Loop L4 (-> Buyer L2 / Dock)

shoppableEnterpriseConnectors.title: Supplier SQF, FDA/ISO Regulatory & COI Gate
shoppableEnterpriseConnectors.runtimeMutation: Versioned overlay injecting Precondition Check [qms.vendor_sqf_status == APPROVED] into WF #1 Step 3 Validation and [coa_lot_verified == true] into WF #3 Step 3 Validation.

shoppableEnterpriseConnectors.title: Outbound EDI 850 PO, 855 Ack & Inbound 856 ASN
shoppableEnterpriseConnectors.runtimeMutation: Versioned overlay binding EDI 850/855/856 adapter into WF #2 Step 4 and pre-populating WF #3 Step 1 BOL & pallet SSCC fields.

shoppableEnterpriseConnectors.title: Quality Lab Hold, Quarantine & Return-to-Vendor (RTV Loop L3)
shoppableEnterpriseConnectors.runtimeMutation: Versioned overlay adding Exception Branch [Loop L3 -> CWFB-P2P08-RTV] on WF #3 Step 3 Validation failure and calculating read-only net payable deduction in WF #4 Step 2.

shoppableEnterpriseConnectors.title: Dual-Control Treasury Payment Run & GR/IR Clearing
shoppableEnterpriseConnectors.runtimeMutation: Versioned overlay chaining WF #4 Exit Event [READY_FOR_PAYMENT] into CWFB-P2P07-PAY S2S deterministic settlement proposal and downstream Enterprise Intelligence Collective (EIC) Gold Medallion Schema GS0004.
